rongmei.title: Paap rih bam khou hei tingkao

lines: 1. Paap rihbam khou hei tingkao guang nah,
Saupirun run lou nimei ta thaina,
Lung rianrana kalum bam khou.
Zeiluang kumna talandui kei getsamani khou,
Nim kan the Israel nun ruina.
Lani makge lani makge Israel
Nang rui lani mak,
Karu khou ti nkhuailou khang mei nun rui phuna
Pilat nang latzan suhan dat ro.
2. Kandih Guangh lani mak Judah nun,
Kalvary ching rukhou hianbin louna,
Kapui meri lung ryanrana,
Munrim gaimei tuai kanmei tei kalung ryanra na,
Guang supui ram tei la mak khou rui.
3. Rianra the tarou lung zing mei khou,
Aniu guang nzaeng mei theipui nung mu,
Zerusalem rakai lung khou
Khamthing phei tei siet kak kanthe baenglani zai the.
Nthanmei kau bumaeng guang datro.
4. Riukan the paaprih adou tang khou,
Kandi hei poubaomei le khrista ram.
Paaprii ta ngam mei guangh daimei,
Nthukpui zeirui liwlou the kalvary ching khou,
Ncham lou kan the Poubaomei rui.
